Code and data to reproduce the article Urban climate regressions require representative monitoring networks, a land use regression (LUR) of nocturnal air temperature during hot spells in Zurich, Switzerland, which combines four reference automatic weather stations (AWS) with an increasing fraction of 117 low-cost sensors (LCS). The code is also available at github.com/martibosch/zurich-uhi-lur (tag arxiv-v1), where the executed notebooks can be browsed.
